name: The Spectral Scythe keeps its scythe model instead of turning into a pig (#7914)
contract: Spectral Scythe 250305 (display 25398, the runebladed sword model) carries Spectral Scythe Passive 500485, whose
periodic trigger casts Show Weapons Only 707188. Its effect 1 transforms the caster into creature 427586, which
does not exist in the world database, so the core fell back to the pink pig 16358. The transform is now a dummy
and the Scythe keeps its own display.

steps.label: SETUP: the Spectral Scythe is summoned
Let the passive's periodic trigger run
DISCRIMINATING: the Scythe shows its own model, not the pig
